title: For fixedP0, matching only its actual cubic and four translations is enough
statement: For fixed P0 only its actual cubic moment and four translation moments require matching. On the selected triad covariance catalogue the exact minimum is kappa^2*2ABD(A+B+2D)/(2AB+D(A+B)) when the denominator is positive, with degenerate cases handled separately or continuously. This is the five-condition Gram optimum for that catalogue, not an optimum over all quadratures or fields. The separate all-eight-cubic construction proves its global amplitude budget without needing this optimized rational cost.
